Firstly, your current Red Mist rank will be displayed next to the timer during challenge missions, this allows you to see how quickly you need to beat a level to secure that coveted 'A' ranking.

Also, now when playing a Hothead mission, your skull combo will start automatically, this ups the challenge a little bit, but it makes the experience just that little more entertaining.

That's it for now, keep your eyes peeled later this week for the release of all this stuff, but with a decidedly linuxy and maccy flavour.

notes.title: Release Notes 1.1.2.458 [WINDOWS ONLY]
notes.content:
Greetings Agents,

It's been a long time between bites but we're back with a HUGE update to Damsel!

This time we're releasing episode 3 "Executive Incentives" and it's our biggest episode yet. Bigger arenas and tougher challenges await, as well as a continuation of the story of Damsel's fight against Red Mist.

You'll also notice that the game has undergone a complete overhaul in terms of looks! We wanted to really lean into our comic book visuals and much has been done to show off the work of our brilliant comic book artist David Fjalarsson (@DavidThorArt on Twitter, seriously, follow him)

[b]PLEASE NOTE: This update may cause some players to lose their game progression. We know this sucks, but it was an unfortunate side effect of the massive update (Which now includes multiple game slots - speedrunners rejoice!). Please forgive the inconvenience.[/b]

Finally, we'd really like to extend a sincere thanks to all the players that have jumped on board the Damsel train over the last six or so months, as well as providing us with all your feedback. This game is yours, and we want it to be the best it can be. We've got plenty more planned for our plucky slayer so keep letting us know what you like and what sucks, we'll be sure to address what we can.

Also, if you want to chat with any of us on the dev team, or discuss speedrunning strategies to get that episode one time below 9 minutes (it's totally possible), feel free to head on over to our discord server at https://discord.gg/g2Rke34

Here's a list of all the things we could remember that have changed :)

[b]Episode 3 - Executive Incentives[/b]
[list]
[*]25 new heart pumping  missions
[*]5 new beautiful environments
[/list]

[b]Mechanical changes[/b]
[list]
[*]'3 shot' system has been replaced with a more traditional 'single shot with cool down' one. Makes the game easier to understand and provides more consistent gameplay.
[*]Stake dive no longer ends skull combo
[*]Skull dashing now releases skulls immediately, the number of skulls is based on the combo level (1-5)
[*]Introduction of toxic barrels. Toxic barrels will weaken enemies if the barrel is shot in their vicinity.
[*]Toxic barrels will reduce Damsel's health to a single heart until the player can shoot or punch a health barrel, which restores health to pre-toxic amounts.
[*]The player is now given a ranking for every Red Mist Challenge they complete.
[/list]

[b]Game Slots and Modes[/b]
[list]
[*]The player is now able to create multiple save slots in a game.
[*]Selecting the game modes Hothead and Chillout have been moved, rather than being able to change mid game you are asked to select a difficulty when you start a new save game.
[/list]

[b]Leaderboards and Achievements[/b]
[list]
[*]New leaderboards have been added to the end of every mission. You can now see the Top Times and Top Scores for every mission.
[*]The leaderboards in game are now cross-platform. You'll be competing against everyone from PC to Console!
[*]Five new Steam Achievements to, well, achieve. Can you shoot 20 coffins without touching the ground?
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
This was a big one and there are still a few rough edges that need attention. Over the coming months, expect us to address the following. Mac and Linux players can also expect a full update in the next couple of weeks.
[list]
[*]Fully rebindable controls.
[*]Quality settings to make the game more stunning if your rig can handle it.
[*]Issues with the Switch Pro controller.
[*]Some weird sound effects here and there.
[*]Some rendering issues with our characters.
[/list]

notes.title: Damsel Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Greetings Agents!

We've released an update for Damsel.

This update mostly contains behind the scenes work for expanding Damsel to multiple platforms, and we're excited to announce that the game is now available for both Linux and macOS. If you do experience issues on these new platforms, let is know and we'll take a look!

We've also made some changes that should make the game more accessible for some of our players. We've added some tweaks to the bomb defusal minigame which include marking the bad wires and rumbling the controller on the good wires. We hope these changes will help out those with certain types of colour blindness.

We've also added an option to the game that swaps out the default font with OpenDyslexic. We hope that this helps some of our players read the comic panels a little easier, though we understand it's not a fix-all for everyone. If there's a particular change or option you think we can make to enhance or enable your experience, let us know and we'll see what we can do.

Here's the full list of changes to the game.

[list]
[*] Linux build live.
[*] macOS build live.

[*] Added OpenDyslexic font.
[*] Timer disabled when chillout mode is active.
[*] Visual updates to lasers.
[*] Controller rumble added to bomb hack minigame.
[*] Visual tweaks added to bomb hack minigame, to aid colourblind players.
[*] Font and language fixes.
[*] Shader fixes for certain hardware configs. 
[/list]

See you on the leaderboards!

- Anthony

notes.title: Damsel Update - 1.0.1.309
notes.content:
Greetings Agents!

We've released an update for Damsel.

This update addressess some balance issues that we think will make your experience with the game a smoother, more entertaining one. The biggest change is the removal of most of the minigames completely. For some time now, these minigames have been a fairly divisive and we ultimately couldn't make them fit in a nice way with the rest of the gameplay. The core of Damsel is speed and precision, and these minigames weren't contributing to that.

The other big change is the increase in Damsel's starting health from one hitpoint to three. One hitpoint was causing frustration for many players and making combat more forgiving means fewer restarts and more time completing missions. Damsel is most enjoyable when you get into the flow of movement and combat and too many deaths took away that opportunity.

Here is the complete list of changes.
[list]
[*] Remove all minigames except hostage rescue and bomb diffusal.
[*] Lower amount of skull combo required for first super skull to one.
[*] Increase starting health on all missions to three.
[*] Lower damage of rockets to two hit points (previously three).
[*] Address issue with some controllers not connecting correctly.
[*] Hacking a server will now spawn two chellenge enemies.
[*] Cracking a safe will now spawn three skulls.
[*] Fix bug where best time is incorrectly recorded.
[*] Fix bug where 0% accuracy is incorrectly reported on mission complete screen.
[*] Increase reload speed of shotgun.
[*] Fix bug where hostages could be shot when just off screen.
[*] Fix bug in bad tutorial that may help better explain the concept of skull dashing.
[*] Fix some bad translations that were showing an error.
[/list]
As always we are open to hearing your thoughts on these and other issues as well. We believe that the game should be a living entity and we don't have any reservations making dramatic changes if we think they will give you a more enjoyable experience.

- Anthony

notes.title: Damsel Road To Release Announcement
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Damsel is entering the final phase of Early Access and will be transitioning to full release on Steam soon.

We would love to thank everyone that has supported us so far – those who have reviewed, streamed, given feedback, played and enjoyed the game, you all rock! We also want to thank our friends and family, without who there wouldn’t even be a game to play. It has been a long journey of over three years and we are excited for this moment to come.

As part of transitioning into full release we’re increasing the price of Damsel. We believe the full price represents great value, and you won’t be disappointed with the content the game has to offer. From 10th September, the regular price of Damsel will be USD$19.99 (or your local equivalent). If you have Damsel on your wish list (or even if you don’t) and want to grab it for its current price of USD$9.99 - now is the perfect opportunity!

There’s also some content that we haven’t added yet that we hope you’ll enjoy. By the time Damsel reaches full release the game will include:
[list]
[*]Dozens of beautiful, hand drawn, comic book cut scenes that tell the story of Damsel's bloody brush with the Red Mist Corporation.
[/list]
Full translation into the following languages:
[list]
[*]German
[*]French
[*]Spanish
[*]Portuguese
[*]Italian
[*]Turkish
[*]Korean
[*]Japanese
[*]Simplified Chinese
[/list]

During this time, we’ll also be working on optimising, fixing bugs, and balancing gameplay to ensure that you have the best Damsel experience.

Thanks for your continued support!

The Screwtape Team
❤ ❤ ❤

notes.title: Update Notes - Selene (0.9.2.1.181)
notes.content:
Agents, the DSA has uploaded a new build of Damsel that addresses the following:

[b]Game Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Episode 3: Executive Incentives is now playable!
[*] Much more health in the game (triple the amount).
[*] Melee attacking a Blood Barrel will now give you the heart without the enemy spawn (usually)
[*] Checkpoint have been rewritten, you're now locked in an area and must keep the enemies at bay (no more satellite breakages)
[*] Flamethrowers now only do one hit point of damage.
[*] Unlimited attempts at the first mission in an arcade challenge.
[*] Three attempts for each additional mission in the arcade challenge, resets each mission.
[*] Chargers now wreak havoc on items in their path (including Blood Barrels, watch out!)
[*] The Rooftops and the Back Alley have a little extra breathing room on the sides of the map.
[*] Add Red Mist advertisement to start of the game to trick you into buying that sweet, sweet, Red Mist.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix bug where touching a black widow will not injure player.
[*] Fix bug where spikes and other hazards will not bump Damsel across the map.
[*] Fix bug where Executive will attack player straight away on one of the later building site missions.
[*] Fix bug where Damsel can wall jump up invisible walls.
[*] Fix bug where skulls can get stuck in walls.
[*] Fix bug where Damsel will not Dash correctly across some floors.
[/list]

[b]And that's all the missions in the game folks! 75 in total. We now enter a phase of balancing and tweaking mission layout and features, so still expect things to change.

Let us know in the forums of any issues you're having, or just to suggest things you might like to see in the game. We can't do everything, but it never hurts to ask :)

Also, if you stream your Damsel game play, let us know so that we can come and silently lurk in the stream, judging you. We've already made some great changes to the game based on watching you play. So please keep it up!

- Anthony [/b]

[*] Fix bug where projectile hit detection is too narrow when projectile moves vertically.
[*] Fix bug where bones do not impact a ducking player.
[*] Fix bug where hostage rescue canvas places 'rope' in incorrect position.
[*] Fix bug where some buttons do not highlight correctly in menus.
[*] Fix (remove) specular reflection on some shaders.
[*] Fix bug where some names in the arcade high score tables would overflow.
[*] Fix bug in "Underground Slums - Destroy Coffins" where an enemy doesn't spawn from one of the cameras.
[*] Fix bug in checkpoints causing mission to not correctly reload.
[*] Fix bug where stake dive only works once per mission.
[/list]
Plus lots of work on [b]Episode 3: Executive Incentives[/b] - Coming Soon!

notes.title: Update Notes - Graf (0.9.1.1.117)
notes.content:
Agents, the DSA has uploaded a new build of Damsel that addresses the following:

[b]Game Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Projectile logic updated to be more robust.
[*] Projectile and Hazard hit effects updated to include impact velocity.
[*] Camera hitbox size doubled.
[*] Black Widow logic rewritten based on gameplay observation.
[*] Enemies no longer attack while player is in a 'Knockdown' state.
[*] Enemy rocket speed reduced.
[*] Executive plasma ball speed reduced.
[*] Executive aiming accuracy made fuzzy.
[*] Episode two arcade mode added.
[*] Weekly challenge arcade mode added.
[*] Arcade leaderboards now visible on arcade menu screen.
[*] Checkpoints and Checkpoint enemy placement improved.
[*] Projectiles now destroy themselves when not on screen.
[*] Enemies will refuse to fire when not on screen.
[*] Projectile ranges removed, all shots including Damsels will travel until leaving the screen.
[*] When in range of a black widow at her death will now remove all extra life earned.
[*] Options panel now more responsive to controller input. Still not perfect though.
[*] Update color of some ladders to make them more visible.
[*] Main menu layout modification.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix bug where lasers don't harm player.
[*] Fix bug where uvshot trails are visible before firing.
[*] Fix direction of rain on The Rooftops.
[*] Remove some particle systems that were causing performance issues.
[*] Fix bug causing enemies to become unresponsive during melee attacks.
[*] Address bug causing black screen when a checkpoint is destroyed during 'upload'.
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Attacks are sometimes effective from below platforms.
[*] No tutorial for dealing with the Beam Mort in mission 'Server Room' (If it shoots you, you have to kill it before getting your shots back)
[*] UI does not update correctly when shot by a Beam Mort.
[*] 'Arcade' button is highlighted by default on main menu, should be 'Campaign'.
[*] Campaign does not yet show story cutscenes.
[*] Minigame UI graphics are incomplete.
[*] Current mission objective does not display on UI.
[/list]
